We had Gaurav Caterers for our cocktail and engagement function — and I can truly say, they made the evening magical. Saba, their head manager and Abhay the owner, was a dream to work with — calm, attentive, and truly invested in making sure everything ran smoothly. In a way, the food helped build a bridge between two worlds — and that’s something we’ll always be grateful for.

Thank you, Gaurav Caterers, for making our special day not just memorable, but deeply meaningful.
